answer: Reputation follows exponential decay with a fixed half-life, so past behavior loses weight and sustained honest service is needed to build durable trust. A fresh identity—even one that can wander among peers or mimic a raven in a trusted grove—has few reciprocal, well-supported links; EigenTrust propagation therefore gives it near-zero eigenvector centrality, leaving it unable to meet consensus thresholds or amplify influence through Sybil copies.
